title: Record the Linux runner's CPU, memory and concurrency cap in runners.md
goal: kb/_self/runners.md says the docker-linux runner's WSL VM is capped at processors=4 and memory=8GB in kb-runner's .wslconfig and the runner runs concurrent = 1, why (the local sync gate and the CI share the host's CPUs; uncapped, local gate tests hit their timeouts), and how the cap is changed (a one-off task as kb-runner, then a VM restart).

run: import pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('kb/_self/runners.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8');assert 'processors=4' in t and 'memory=8GB' in t and 'concurrent = 1' in t
